dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, crenulated high-contrast perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior background to the light-colored ring boundary, which then surrounds a lower-intensity (darker) internal core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters that lack internal gradients. These clusters are primarily distributed in the anterior region near the neck and along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral; the spatial relationships show relatively uniform spacing between the centers of these structures along the longitudinal axis.
